identity.name: Graphiti
identity.one_liner: Temporal knowledge graph memory system for agents that need facts, entities, and time-aware context.
identity.short_description: Graphiti is an open-source temporal knowledge graph system from Zep for building agent memory that tracks entities, relationships, and changing facts over time.

positioning.why_it_matters: Graphiti matters because memory is often relational and time-sensitive. Agents need to know not only what was said, but when it was true and how it connects to other facts.
best_for: Builders who need graph memory instead of simple chat history
Teams working with changing entities, relationships, or customer context
Developers exploring temporal memory for agent systems
not_for: Users who want a fully managed consumer product with no setup work
Teams that cannot review the linked source, license, and operational requirements before adoption

core_strengths.title: Temporal knowledge graph model
core_strengths.description: Graphiti represents memory as entities and relationships with time-aware context.
core_strengths.why_it_matters: This helps agents reason about changing facts instead of flattening everything into chunks.

core_strengths.title: Agent memory orientation
core_strengths.description: The project is built for agent and assistant memory workflows.
core_strengths.why_it_matters: It focuses on recall structures that matter to agents, not just generic graph storage.

core_strengths.title: Open-source implementation
core_strengths.description: The repository and docs provide a concrete path for evaluation.
core_strengths.why_it_matters: Graph memory is easier to trust when the implementation is inspectable.

seo_article.intro: Graphiti is an open-source temporal knowledge graph system from Zep for building agent memory that tracks entities, relationships, and changing facts over time.
seo_article.what_it_is: Graphiti is an open memory-system resource to evaluate by what it stores, how recall works, how memory is scoped, and whether users or teams can inspect, correct, export, or delete durable context.
seo_article.why_it_matters: Graphiti matters because memory is often relational and time-sensitive. Agents need to know not only what was said, but when it was true and how it connects to other facts.
seo_article.how_it_works: Test Graphiti with repeated sessions. Add facts, update them, ask for recall, inspect retrieval behavior, and verify deletion or scoping controls before storing sensitive user or project memory.

faq.question: What should I check before using Graphiti?
faq.answer: Test Graphiti with repeated sessions. Add facts, update them, ask for recall, inspect retrieval behavior, and verify deletion or scoping controls before storing sensitive user or project memory.

faq.question: Is Graphiti open source?
faq.answer: Graphiti is listed with Apache-2.0 based on the official source links in this profile. Re-check the repository, model card, or docs before production use.

faq.question: Who should evaluate Graphiti?
faq.answer: Graphiti is most worth evaluating for builders who need graph memory instead of simple chat history.
